attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to gain persistence, privilege escalation or proxy execution on the endpoint using scheduled tasks.
description: An uncommon process was executed by a scheduled task.
investigative_actions: Review the process executed by the schedule task. Investigate the specific scheduled task execution chain. Check if the vendor is known in the organization for creating scheduled tasks to execute his product.
